title: Schedule and Budget Drawn Up for Scheme to Prioritise Inspection of Condition of Occupied HDB Rental Flats
what_it_is: Schedule and Budget Drawn Up for Scheme to Prioritise Inspection of Condition of Occupied HDB Rental Flats

sections.label: HDB rental flat inspections
sections.summary: HDB aims to resume proactive inspection and maintenance of occupied rental flats, disrupted by COVID-19 measures, and is studying options such as outsourcing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: asked Minister for National Development (a) whether an update can be provided on the revised approach to prioritise inspections of occupied HDB rental flats; and (b) what is the annual schedule and budget allotted under the revised approach for proactive regular maintenance of these flats beyond the repairs requested by tenants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: However, this practice was disrupted when COVID-19 Safe Management Measures (SMMs) were imposed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Currently, HDB conducts physical inspections in response to tenants' feedback and seeks to do so promptly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, HDB aims to resume the proactive inspection and maintenance regime, and is studying options, such as outsourcing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We will share more details on the revised approach when ready.

sections.label: Rental flat repairs and assistance
sections.summary: HDB offers repairs or replacements for spoiled fittings and fixtures, while aesthetic items are tenants' responsibility, with community and grassroots organisations assisting needy tenants.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I would also like to thank her for being proactive and working in partnership with our officers on the ground to see how we can help our rental tenants.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I want to assure the Member and the House that we are studying various options.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: While we offer repairs or replacements for fittings and fixtures of rental flats if they are spoiled or dysfunctional, that is one part.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For items which are aesthetic and less functional, these are essentially the tenants' responsibility.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Nevertheless, for the needy ones, this would be where we work with community organisations and grassroots organisations, to assist them.
